authorization.excludes: complete archives, original identifiers, and participant-indexed mappings
authorization.scope: three anonymous trial-curve illustrations and their plotted coordinates

conditions.content: Full video content; participant × released-video holdout
conditions.residual: Content + current/past EEG/fNIRS; primary full-modality candidate, not disabled fallback
conditions.sam: Post-trial SAM + same-video training library; participant holdout, known video
conditions.target: Observed joystick report; valence then arousal, 1–255

selection.criterion: mean absolute error across all trial seconds and both axes
selection.method: nearest ranked trial to content-prior MAE percentiles 25, 50, 75
selection.tie_break: stable original participant/video ordering (mapping retained privately)
